import view

def test_basic():
    v = view.View()
    rid1 = v.begin('q1')
    assert rid1 == 1
    assert v.get_loading() == False
    rows1 = [1,2]
    ok1 = v.finish(rid1, rows1)
    assert ok1 == True
    assert v.rows == rows1
    # copy rows
    copy1 = v.copy_accepted_rows()
    assert copy1 == rows1
    # notes empty
    # begin again
    rid2 = v.begin('q2')
    assert rid2 == 2
    # finish with wrong id
    ok2 = v.finish(rid1, [3,4])
    assert ok2 == False  # not latest
    # finish again with same id (duplicate) should fail
    ok3 = v.finish(rid1, [5,6])
    assert ok3 == False  # already finished
    # finish with correct id
    rows2 = [7,8]
    ok4 = v.finish(rid2, rows2)
    assert ok4 == True
    assert v.rows == rows2
    # copy after finish
    copy2 = v.copy_accepted_rows()
    assert copy2 == rows2
    # notes persistence
    v.notes[42] = 'note1'
    # begin again
    rid3 = v.begin('q3')
    assert rid3 == 3
    # finish with wrong id fails
    ok5 = v.finish(rid2, [9,10])
    assert ok5 == False
    # finish correct id works
    rows3 = [11,12]
    ok6 = v.finish(rid3, rows3)
    assert ok6 == True
    assert v.rows == rows3
    # notes still there
    assert v.notes[42] == 'note1'
    # loading cleared on begin
    assert v.get_loading() == False
    # rows not cleared on begin, only updated on valid finish
    # initial empty rows
    v2 = view.View()
    rid1b = v2.begin('q1b')
    assert rid1b == 1
    # no finish yet, rows empty
    # begin again without finish
    rid2b = v2.begin('q2b')
    assert rid2b == 2
    # finish first id should fail
    okb1 = v2.finish(rid1b, [1])
    assert okb1 == False
    # finish second id should work
    rowsb2 = [2]
    okb2 = v2.finish(rid2b, rowsb2)
    assert okb2 == True
    assert v2.rows == rowsb2

def test_duplicate_finish():
    v = view.View()
    rid = v.begin('q')
    rows = [1]
    ok = v.finish(rid, rows)
    assert ok == True
    # duplicate finish
    ok2 = v.finish(rid, [2])
    assert ok2 == False

def test_error_clear():
    v = view.View()
    rid = v.begin('q')
    # set error manually
    v.error = 'some error'
    assert v.error == 'some error'
    rid2 = v.begin('q2')
    # begin clears error
    assert v.error is None

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_basic()
    test_duplicate_finish()
    test_error_clear()
    print('All tests passed')
